verdict.rationale: Microsoft ships an official Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit CLI, documented as offering the same features as the IDE extensions—agent/app creation from templates, resource provisioning/deployment to Azure, validation/packaging/publishing, and preview—directly supporting AI-native agentic workflows for Teams apps/agents. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of CLI usage and no evidence of scripting/automation depth (e.g., CI/CD examples) beyond first-party docs.
